attempts.rationale: The series has strong seasonality and unstable ranking, so a robust weighted combination over all models is a good first test.
Test a trimmed mean to see if removing the highest‑error models helps; the series is seasonal dominated so a robust aggregator may improve over plain mean.
I want to test a different weighting scheme than softmax; use inverse_error to see if simple error‑based weighting helps.
The series shows strong seasonality and unstable ranking; a simple mean over the full pool may provide a robust baseline different from weighted schemes.
The series is seasonal dominated with unstable ranking; a per‑horizon best‑model selection may capture horizon‑specific strengths.
Seasonal dominance and unstable ranking suggest a robust non‑parametric combo; a median over all models may be a distinct strategy type.
The series is strongly seasonal with unstable ranking; a DBA (dynamic Bayesian averaging) may exploit complementary models more than simple weighting.
The series has unstable ranking and strong seasonality; a robust weighted combo on a more focused pool (pool4) may improve performance.
Test a per-horizon robust weighted combo on a smaller, diverse pool (pool4) using inverse_error to see if a focused subset improves performance.
Use a per‑horizon one‑hot weighting (best_per_horizon) on the full model pool to see if horizon‑specific leaders improve performance.
Test shrinked inverse error weighting on full model set

decision.justification: Selected 'weighted weighted by w3' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.8539. Series context: trend strength 0.2145 and seasonal strength 0.7654; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.049); 10 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 1.652.
